This game is the perfect example of why steam should add a NEUTRAL rating.

I love rhythm games, and love this "dodge the beat" style game. I played "Just shapes and beats" and loved it, and I love this game too. But the thing that really holds this game back is its slow development and that it heavily relies on community made levels.
If this game had a community as large as osu! this wouldn't be a problem, but it doesn't.. and this leaves it with less content than I'd like. 

Of course I understand we all stared somewhere, and this being a small indie developer I really commend the team for what they built. But this game, even after the many years its been out now, it still feels like a preview.

I wanna make sure everyone who reads this understands, I love this game, but It just doesn't have enough content
Just shapes and beats but with community-made and harder levels (still peak tho)

The story is Incredibly short currently, however it's a really promising project. I could definitely see this taking over Just Shape and Beat's legacy once it's fully released.
The levels themselves are a lot more complex than Just Shapes and Beats ever was, the telegraphy is much better too, again at least for the campaign.
There's a pretty extensive workshop community, with thousands of custom levels to pick from. I could see this expanding tenfold after the game fully releases. Time will tell of that though.

All in all, if you liked Just Shapes and Beats and want more, this is definitely something you should try at least once.
